newsitem.title: USA: Family Bargain Jan same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Family Bargain Jan same-store sales rise.

text.p: Family Bargain Corp Thursday said January 1997 sales for the five-week period were $14.9 million compared with $9.6 million for the four weeks ended January 1996.
For a comparable four-week period this year compared with last year, January 1997 sales rose 20.4 percent while same-store sales increased by 5.4 percent.

The company said sales for the fiscal year ended January 1997 rose to $252.2 million from $179.8 a year ago. The January 1997 fiscal year consisted of 53 weeks. For a comparable 52-week period this year compared with last year, sales rose 38.40 percent and same-store sales rose 5.9 percent.

Family Bargain Corp said it operates 150 "Family Bargain Center" and "Factory 2-U" off-price retail stores which sell primarily first quality clothing for men, women and children, and household goods at prices which generally are significantly lower than the prices offered by its competitors.
Stores are located in California, Arizona, New Mexico, Washington, Nevada, Texas and Oregon.
